title: Belt cleanup
description: A Mire Corsairs scout is shadowing the ore haulers out of the Solace belts. Cull it and dock at Haven Rest to collect the bounty office's fee.

title: Supply run to Penumbra Port
description: Penumbra Port is low on EMP charges. Buy 200 rounds (2 m³) on the Haven Rest market and deliver them to the Port's hangar — one gate jump through low security. The cargo is the delivery: do not spend it on the way.

title: Cordite order
description: Haven Rest's refinery needs 400 m³ of raw cordite. Fill the ore hold at the Solace belt and dock to turn the order in.
